newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish ITI sets $35 mln placement, eyes listing.
newsitem.headline: Polish ITI sets $35 mln placement, eyes listing.

text.p: Poland's multimedia group ITI-Group plans a private placement to raise $35 million to develop its Polish cinema and television operations, the group's chief executive said on Wednesday.

Jan Wejchert told Reuters that ITI -- which has operations in advertising, film distribution, home video, film production and snack foods -- sought funding to expand its core media activity by developing a chain of multiplex cinemas and bidding for television broadcast licences.
"The money raised from the placement would go towards the development of a multiplex cinema chain and also for our television project," Wejchert said.
He said the offer, scheduled for mid-November, would be mainly placed in Europe, but that it would be also available to U.S. investors.
Wejchert said ITI would likely seek flotation in the next two or three years after its media investments started bearing fruit.
"We expect to enter the Warsaw bourse and perhaps simultaneously another important foreign exchange in the next two to three years," Wejchert said.
"But first we want to complete our cinema and television projects...which we see as engines of our further development," he added.

The issue's lead manager Carnegie AB said in a report that ITI's plan to develop 10 Multikino multi-screen cinemas and its television venture called TVN -- which seeks licences to broadcast in two highly populated regions -- offered strong growth potential.
Multikino is ITI's joint-venture with UCI, a unit of Paramount/Universal, and TNV is a venture with U.S. media firm CME, a leading broadcaster in Central and Eastern Europe.
ITI netted $3.3 million on sales of $64.6 million in 1995.
Carnegie estimated the value of ITI Group at $128 million.
